t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The number of mushrooms in each basket varies throughout the game. One will have more then slowly become less as the game goes on. Once that basket reaches 1 or 0, switch over to the other basket. Yellow baskets correspond to yellow, orange, blue and (forgot the colour) gnomes while the red baskets correspond to red, purple, brown and pink gnomes

vb_textbox.text: Red, purple, brown and pink gnomes are linked to the red basket while yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes are linked to the yellow basket. It seems like throughout the game the number of mushrooms in each basket vary i.e. you'll get more in the red basket for a number of go's then it will switch to the yellow basket having more mushrooms. You have to trial and error at the start to see which one is retrieivng more mushrooms.
